name: Welcome to IDLB
source:
"How are you doing today? I'm Rin'e Hijikawa ♪

This would be sudden but, are you interested in idols?

Whether you are interested or not, let's have a cup of tea in the club room first ♪

Welcome to the Idol Literature Club ♪"

[Translated from [url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/welcome-to-idlb]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“今天怎么样？我是比地川凛惠♪

虽然很突然，但是你对偶像感兴趣吗？

不管有没有兴趣，先去俱乐部房间喝杯茶吧♪

欢迎来到偶像文学部♪”

[译自[url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/welcome-to-idlb]itch.io[/url]]
